name: Access Filter
description: Deny or allow HTTP requests early via an HTTP middleware, using configurable filters that match request conditions (path, URI, cookie, session, $_SERVER/header, AND/OR) and evaluate IP allow/deny rules.
project_description: Access Filter provides request-level access control implemented as an HTTP middleware. Each filter is a configuration entity combining conditions (which requests it applies to) with rules (allow/deny by IP address) and a response (code, redirect URL, or custom body). Conditions target the Drupal path, full request URI with query string, a session/cookie/$_SERVER value, or nested AND/OR groups, and can be negated. Rules match a single IP, a CIDR subnet (192.168.0.0/24), a range (192.168.0.1-192.168.0.10), or the '*' wildcard. Paths, URIs and value comparisons can use regular expressions. Filters run before Drupal routing and can be disabled globally with $settings['access_filter_disabled'] = TRUE.
